title: Petra and the Rivergate
author: Rafael Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Winterbourne, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
